notes.title: Flashover MegaSector 1.0.1 released!
notes.notes:
Flashover MegaSector 1.0.1 has released. It's a relatively small update, but what was changed was new content of a sort. Mainly, the updated has ​added an option to select fancier backgrounds.​

Enjoy!

P.S. Sorry about the "missing executable" error for a few minutes there when trying to launch the game from Steam, that's on me for not actually remembering to rename the EXE. Reminder to self to not be stupid next time. That being said if you still get one, check the game folder, the EXE is probably actually still there.

notes.title: Flashover MegaSector is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Sorry for not really announcing a proper release date in advance, we weren't 100% sure when it was going to be out either. But starting right now, Flashover MegaSector is available for purchase on Steam! Blast your way through five fast-paced stages which change based on what enemies you beat in the previous stage.

Find the game too hard? No worries, increase your life count and the game is much easier, though you'll incur a higher score penalty for each death the more lives you start with. Find the game too easy? Set your lives to 0 and try to beat every stage without getting hit once! [i]Still[/i] find the game too easy? Go for the harder tasks listed at the bottom of the screen in any given stage, and avoid accomplishing the ones that make stages easier.

If you have any feedback on the game, please post it on the forums! I'd be glad to listen, and try my best to either make changes, or if the changes needed to fix the issue would be too complex, I can at least try to explain as best as possible why.

Oh, and keep your eyes peeled for further updates... I already have a few updates planned anyways, but as I said, I want to do my best to implement changes based on popular requests too.

I hope you all enjoy the game!
